name: Rapier
role: Rust/WASM 2D and 3D physics with optional cross-platform determinism and world snapshots
summary: Dimforge's physics engine compiled to WebAssembly, with separate 2D and 3D npm packages (-compat builds inline the WASM and need `await RAPIER.init()`). Fixed-step replay from t: set the world timestep to 1/fps and step n times, or step once and cache per-frame transforms; takeSnapshot/restoreSnapshot allow checkpoints so seeking need not restart from zero. Upstream describes an opt-in cross-platform determinism mode.
use_when: 3D physics beside Three.js or R3F, via react-three-rapier
Over Matter.js for big piles, joints, or reproducible results across machines
Checkpointing the world so frame f is computed from the nearest snapshot
avoid_when: A handful of 2D bodies with no WASM wanted: Matter.js
Scripted motion with no collisions: GSAP or Theatre.js
Soft bodies and cloth: Rapier does not provide them
notes: 2026-10-26: The pages fetched point to separate Determinism and Serialization guides; flags and snapshot API details were not read, so the replay recipe is unvalidated. Use @dimforge/rapier2d-compat for 2D.

assessment.rationale: Frequent npm releases (0.19.3 Nov 2025, 0.20.0 Aug 2026, 0.21.0 Sept 2026); Apache-2.0; 2D and 3D from one project with a determinism option.
